info.title: Journal Management System API
info.description: A professional RESTful API for the Journal Management System SaaS platform. All journal content endpoints are scoped by journal slug: `/api/v1/journals/{journalSlug}/...`. The publications list endpoint supports a `country` filter that matches any author affiliation country (not just the corresponding author), consistent with MDPI-style multi-country attribution.

bearerAuth.description: API token for authenticated endpoints. Create tokens in your account settings. All GET endpoints are public; POST/PUT/DELETE require authentication.

Retrieve a specific issue with all its publications.

Retrieve publications with filtering, search, and pagination. The country filter matches any author affiliation — a publication is included if any of its authors (not just the corresponding author) has an affiliation in the specified country.
